task.subject: fix: show custom error message in prompt with hide_input=True

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/termui.py
+++ b/src/click/termui.py
@@ -188,11 +188,26 @@ def prompt(
         try:
             result = value_proc(value)
         except UsageError as e:
             if hide_input:
-                echo(_("Error: The value you entered was invalid."), err=err)
+                message = e.message
+
+                if value:
+                    quoted = repr(value)
+
+                    if quoted in message:
+                        # The type included the value in quoted (repr) form,
+                        # so it can be located and masked without leaking it.
+                        message = message.replace(quoted, "'***'")
+                    elif str(value) in message:
+                        # The raw value was included and can't be masked
+                        # reliably, so don't risk echoing it back.
+                        message = _("The value you entered was invalid.")
+
+                echo(_("Error: {message}").format(message=message), err=err)
             else:
                 echo(_("Error: {e.message}").format(e=e), err=err)
             continue
